description: PERMANENTLY delete one VM, its disk and its IP. Irreversible — only use when the user has clearly asked. Set confirm to true to execute; without it the call returns a summary of what would be deleted. Requires the "delete" permission.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

name: edge_delete_vm
